card.name: First letters of new section headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a capitalized word that starts a new heading or bullet right after the previous heading or section number, such as M in Malignancies or Meningitis, W in (Wet), or Ant in Antihypertensive.

modes.label: M at heading start
modes.description: The letter M beginning Malignancy or Meningitis right after a section number, colon or bullet.

modes.label: Other heading starts
modes.description: Short opening pieces such as W in (Wet) or Ant in Antihypertensive or Anticholinergic at the start of a new heading or paragraph.
